Welcome to the largest packaging distribution network in the USA.Packform has reimagined the way packaging is bought and sold - powered by technology, driven by AI.

FAIRER

Better terms and a supply chain that works for everyone, not just the big players.

FASTER

Quotes delivered in less than 1hr. Every order tracked from brief to delivery, visible on a shared dashboard.

COMPETITIVE

The best rates in the market. Better pricing, better terms, across the entire supply chain.

WE KNOW PACKAGING

Real packaging experts in your corner, every step of the way.

WHAT IS PACKFORM

The AI-powered platform changing the way packaging is bought and sold.

Packform connects customers, suppliers, and sales professionals in one platform, replacing the archaic processes of the past with an effortless system that makes your life easier.

Customers

Source smarter. Pay less. Get packaging built around your business, with expert support every step of the way.

Sales professionals

Everything you need to manage quotes, close deals, and grow your packaging business - in one place.

Suppliers

Stop chasing leads. Let our sales network bring the buyers to you.

HOW IT WORKS

A platform without limits.

We've built the infrastructure the future of packaging can run on.

One shared system.1
Customers, sales professionals and suppliers interact on one platform. Jobs are briefed, quoted, assigned and approved in one place. Set up is seamless. Repeat orders are almost instant.
Competitive pricing.2
Thousands of suppliers are matched to every job. AI tools provide guidance on pricing taking into account real time factors. Sales professionals get access to more suppliers. Customers receive the best price for the job.
Custom solutions now standard.3
A digital interface handles custom dimensions, materials and quantities instantly. Dealerships and the platform work together to find you the best price - in minutes, not days.

TAKE THE LEAD

Are you ready to outperform the pack?

Join the fastest-growing network of packaging experts and forward-thinking brands, shaping a new industry.

Start your own Dealership

Build your own packaging business without the "back-office" burden.

Buy packaging

Browse thousands of curated products from verified suppliers.

Partner as a Supplier

Open up a world of opportunities on a platform that makes demand predictable.
